synopsis: On the Groq path, two of nine debrief attempts produced an accepted summary. The oak summary was accurate and usefully named the water shortfall; the lake summary had the right priorities but drifted from the receipt (route framing, an asserted end position) and offered unsupported medication storage workarounds. Failures were all reported honestly. tool_use_failed was the dominant failure before restarted Groq feature turns stopped offering tools (3/3 in run-11b9, 0/3 after in run-342c). Payload size still blocks lake and pine in some runs, one pine attempt failed schema validation twice, and one oak attempt was rejected for citing a record outside its queries. A Groq resources attempt returned completed with no plans, which mislabels a pending-information outcome as delivery.

fact_findings.finding: Removal of routes and info events coincides with the lake summary inventing route and position details; choices array itself is retained.
Another household's refrigerator is suggested although the receipt cuts power to the flooded area; no basis that the neighbor has power.
Medication named from the ID token in 8a81ca5e.

services/ai-orchestrator/src/provider-fallback.ts compactForGroq, fitGroqContext, GroqPrivateProvider restarted flag; services/ai-orchestrator/src/features.ts debriefOutput and evidence validation (worktree wf_bce6b49a-568-1 ac55f81)
recommendations: Compaction for debrief: keep the choices with their simMinute and recommended flags plus a one-line host-computed outcome per choice (for example relocation blocked: no destination) instead of dropping all info-level events; keep route status as a single enum per person rather than the full route object.
When fitGroqContext withholds any host result, the feature must not return completed with empty output; map an empty plan list or a missing-records question to status pending or unavailable.
State output limits in the Groq instruction (summary at most about 450 characters, at most two focusTaskIDs) and capture Zod issue paths in the protected bundle.
Seed the feature's retrieved-evidence set with record IDs present in hostRetrievedRecords on restart.
When a restart has no host records, either have the host perform the standard initial read before calling Groq or skip Groq for that operation, rather than offering tools Groq misformats.
Debrief prompt: never propose specific storage workarounds for medication; direct the family to pharmacist or manufacturer guidance (already the Codex behavior).
retests: Repeat run-342c pattern 3x per family after the compaction and limit changes: pass if accepted at least 7/9, zero invented route or position claims, zero completed-empty outcomes.
Synthetic: restart with a withheld host result must yield pending/unavailable, never completed with empty plans.
limitations: Gemini failures in these runs look injected or circuit-open (about 1 ms), so these runs test Groq only.
Only two accepted Groq debriefs exist; quality conclusions are low-n.
Code inspection used a worktree commit close to but not necessarily identical to each run.
